arguments.literal: Acceptance exhausts the instance and interval; further work against it is preservation, a named prerequisite for another admitted outcome, or a new change requiring repricing.
Acceptance is the decision owner's disposition over an unchanged subject; recording it cannot widen it, and it exhausts only the instance and interval it names.

The subject is frozen by identity before material reference exposure; the assessor records its expectations from the governing source before opening the candidate; it reads the subject at a named immutable identity, never a working tree; it makes no repair; it does not assess its own authorship.
Promotion needs independent assessment.
The assessor evaluates the exact live subject, authority paths, proof and installed state, not the constructor's summary.
Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.

A case names its subject, the mechanism under test, the independently specified expected distinction, and its status; status is recorded when an actor other than the author runs it under EVALUATION's independent assessment and method qualification rules.

A case passes when the expected distinction is observed and no coerced success appears anywhere in the result; a case that cannot be run with the declared subject returns out_of_frame, which is recorded, not hidden.

The chain runs Goals, Intent, Product Definition, Requirements (WHAT), Design and realisation (HOW, per tenant), Code or documents, Events, Projection, Delta, Scenarios, Gap analysis, Repricing. Each layer narrows ambiguity for the next: goals narrow focus, intent direction, product the current shape and terms, requirements obligation, tenant choice the realisation class, design structure, implementation detail.
A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.

A claim's quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed its evaluated evidence; generalising a local observation needs a declared inference relation, the comparable population and explicit counterexample treatment.
A closed result is reused by an unchanged consumer after an applicability check; a role, conversation or resumption change alone invalidates nothing.
A work item closes by the condition it stated, not by a reviewer's approval; a reviewer result is an input to closure, never the closure.
A realisation conforms to a specification Σ when its interpreted behaviour satisfies Σ under a declared interpretation contract and an independent judgment.
Conformance of a tenant is judged under EVALUATION's conformance rule; two conforming tenants need not behave identically outside the contract.
Later counterevidence arrives.
Every dependent verdict is invalidated until the claim-evidence relation is requalified.
accept, local_repair, re_enter and reject are what the decision owner does with an assessed candidate; a disposition consumes a core result and is not one.
A valid parse, a valid map, a green test and a historical judgment each establish exactly their own claim.

The evaluator applies the activated frame's declared invariants, evidence rules and result algebra. It distinguishes semantic law, observed evidence, inference and decision, and records every assumption whose failure could change the result.
P6
A finding without evidence a consumer can chase is commentary.
Whether two activations of one actor family are independent for a semantic judgment is a policy the governing basis states for the claim.
Where no policy is stated, the default is that they are not independent.
A judgment is recorded over an unchanged subject with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation.
Green labels, document counts, review counts and historical outcomes are not acceptance.

Semantic law defines what an evaluation means; evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared relation; decision authority disposes; one actor may perform several and the record keeps them distinguishable.
A layer is sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer from it; derivation need not be unique; failure to derive is a defect of the upper layer.

The method is qualified the way it qualifies anything else: a fresh competent constructor, inside a declared envelope, using only the declared ordinary method and authority surfaces and declared trial subjects, with material reference outcomes, incumbent realisations, author memory and ad hoc rescue withheld until freeze wherever earlier exposure would compromise reconstructive independence; then an independent evaluator compares the frozen result with the method's mandatory relation population.

Standing: conserves Method Self-Qualification, which leaves the constructor, freeze and assessor protocols to the governing authority, and RF-013 for reconstructability; the surfaces rule and the conditional withholding conserve UP-022's qualification protocol.

The boundary between out_of_frame and indeterminate is drawn on what the activated frame declares and on what the step did with it. out_of_frame when the claim requires a material relation or an evaluator capability that the activated frame does not declare; whether the step exercised anything is irrelevant to this member, the ground is the missing declaration. indeterminate when every relation and capability the claim requires is declared and was exercised in the step, and the admissible evidence still cannot decide. These two cases restate RF-012's members with the boundary made explicit; a declared capability the step did not exercise is a third case and a member of neither.
P5; rc.2 RF #rf-012-closed-results
A missing, failed or out-of-scope result returns its own member, never satisfied.
A finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps; each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope; the actor's internal path within a step is its own.
Standing: recovered as a composite; the generic statement is reframed from the graph profile's graph functions.
Subject, representation and interpretation are distinct; meaning holds within a declared context through a declared contract.
Standing: independent. With purpose, identity, evidence and authority fixed, two contracts give one representation two meanings.
A selected outcome defines adequacy; interfaces inherit material obligations from the transformation they serve.
Standing: independent. Identical capacity serves opposite purposes.

A step can meet a condition outside its context and cannot report success on one; its result algebra carries indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis as first-class outcomes and its control model names the next move.
Standing: derived.
Definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.
Standing: independent. A bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green label as acceptance.
The candidate is revised after exposure to the assessor.
The revision is a declared intervention and a new subject.
The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next; a later actor may re-acquire declared sources but not a prior actor's private memory.
A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.
The world is open: a step may meet conditions outside its selected context.
P0 presupposes a selected outcome (P2).

A human decision may be exercised directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy whose grant names its scope and exclusions; a proxy cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design; such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Qualification binds the exact frame revision, actor envelope, evaluation family, basis class and evidence conditions evaluated. It does not generalise to an unevaluated population by naming the frame generically.
P6
A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.
One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.
Reusing the constructor's judgment does not satisfy independence; shared mechanical evidence may be reused, judgment may not.
A reused judgment does not satisfy a separately required independent judgment; the independent assessor acquires its own evidence and supplies its own judgment.
A review recommends a disposition; it does not apply one.

A review returns one core result for each declared predicate it evaluated, with the exact subject and basis, the evidence consulted, the findings ranked by consequence, each finding's evidence and smallest bounded correction, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions.

Semantic law defines what the evaluation means; evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared relation; where the evaluation performs a material operation the existing operation owner supplies the exact grant; decision authority disposes the result. A frame declaration keeps these roles distinguishable even when one actor lawfully performs several of them. EVALUATION section 2 applies this to review.
P6

Every evaluation returns a member of its declared result algebra. The core algebra is defined once, in ACTIVATION section 3 (satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame, invalid_basis) with the no-coercion rule; this member does not define it a second time. An externally owned compatible extension may refine that algebra while preserving explicit indeterminate, out-of-frame and invalid-basis pressure; it may neither add a core member nor coerce one to success.
P5
A constructor's self-review is construction output, not assessment.
Several realisations may conform to one Σ; sufficiency does not require unique derivation or equality with an incumbent.

A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.

Frame disjointness is structural; evaluation independence is procedural; assurance independence is claim-relative and stated by the governing assurance law (EVALUATION section 3). Disjoint frames need not be independently evaluated; independently activated evaluations need not be disjoint; and the unqualified word independent establishes none of the three.
P6, P1

symbols.label: Acceptance: the decision owner's disposition over an unchanged subject, exhausting only the instance and interval it names

Activated frame: one frame declaration bound to an exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary; a reusable declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct
Applicability check: the check an unchanged consumer performs before reusing a closed result
Independent assessment protocol: freeze, expectations, named identity, no repair, no own authorship
Assessor: the relation that evaluates a frozen candidate independently

Assurance independence (claim-relative): the non-authorship, evidence-acquisition, reference-exposure, actor and configuration separation the governing assurance law requires for a verdict to count as independent assurance

Authority: an identity-bearing permission to operate or to dispose acceptance within a scope; never minted from capability, label or reachability; its kinds are frame-set, semantic, evaluation, operation and decision authority
Change class: goal_reprice, intent_reprice, product_reprice, requirement_reprice, design_reframe or realization_refactor, each with its re-entry point
Claim: an assertion with subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier

Closed result: identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions; minimal shape REFERENCE_FRAME section 13; available for reuse under an applicability check
Closure condition: the condition a work item stated for its own closure
Conformance: a realisation's interpreted behaviour satisfies a specification under a declared interpretation contract and an independent judgment
Conformance case: subject, mechanism under test, independently specified expected distinction, status
The chain Goals, Intent, Product Definition, Requirements, Design and realisation, Code or documents, Events, Projection, Delta, Scenarios, Gap analysis, Repricing
Constructor: the relation that produces the candidate and self-review
Decision authority: the role permitted to accept, reject or otherwise dispose a result
Decision owner: the relation that disposes

Evaluation independence (procedural): separately activated evaluations neither consume nor influence one another's unclosed working results, though they may inspect the same subject, overlap and later supply closed results to one conjunction
Evaluator: the relation that applies the declared relation between law and evidence

Evidence: the exact observations or artifacts admitted to evaluate a claim on a basis, each with provenance, subject identity, basis and scope; availability inside a frame makes it neither semantic truth nor decision authority
Finding: an evidence-bearing item of a review with its smallest bounded correction
Frame disjointness (structural): two frames share no material variable, coordinate, evidence or result dependency for the declared evaluations
Frame qualification: the nine-test minimum evaluation of a candidate frame, in proportion to its claims
Declared policy on whether two activations of one actor family are independent for a semantic judgment
Judgment: a recorded evaluation over an unchanged subject, with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation
A layer of the chain; sufficient when a competent actor can derive a conformant next layer
Qualification of the method itself: a fresh constructor inside a declared envelope, then an independent evaluator against the mandatory relation population
Outcome U: a selected, owner-defined, directly verifiable state with an acceptance interval
P0 Bounded construction
P1 Interpretation
P2 Purpose
P3 Identity
P4a Typed composition
P5 Totality
P6 Justification and authority
Proxy: an explicitly admitted bounded relation through which a human decision is exercised
falsified: a declared counterexample defeats it
indeterminate: admissible evidence cannot decide it
invalid_basis: the subject or basis cannot support the evaluation
out_of_frame: the evaluation needs an undeclared material relation or capability
satisfied: the declared predicate holds on the exact basis

Reference frame: a finite specification of the attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and result relations required to perform one declared evaluation family over a stated basis; its components are the frame tuple
Refinement: ambiguity outcome (resolved, carried, escalated, blocked)
Refinement: construction availability (candidate_ready, refused, incomplete, re_entry_requested)
Refinement: disposition (accept, local_repair, re_enter, reject)
Refinement: profile-defined closure decisions
The one core result algebra for every evaluation and stop state
Review result: one core result per declared predicate with subject, basis, evidence, ranked findings, residual uncertainty, invalidation conditions and a recommended disposition
RF-007 Semantic, evidence and verdict separation: a law every declared or activated frame obeys
RF-012 Closed results: a law every declared or activated frame obeys
Self-review: a constructor's own review of its candidate
Semantic fidelity: meaning and materiality
Semantic law: what an evaluation means
Specification Σ: the contract a realisation is judged to conform to
Step-produced fact: a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; a reproducible observation is not one
Subject: the thing a claim, representation or transformation is about; exact, with inventory and bytes or semantic addresses
An independent realisation (HOW) located by a product definition's how.build_tenants bindings; derivative until its governing truth is ratified
